Coram : VIKRAMAJIT SEN*, C. NAGAPPAN
Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 - s. 12 - Criminal contempt - Contempt petition before High Court - Alleging that the C contemnor, in a public meeting, while criticizing a judgment passed by a Division Bench of the High Court used abusive language against the judges - High Court found the contemnor contemnor has rightly been held guilty- The contents of his speech show that o it was not a mere criticism of the judgment, but the contemnor by using abusive words against the Judges had intended to lower the dignity of the Court, to obstruct and impede its functioning - The right of freedom
Decision Date : 30-01-2015 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 2099/2011 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
